scientific_config_validation.scope: Only available configs are checked; missing configs do not establish comparability.

selection.sum_rmse: Minimum valid Q_rmse + I_rmse + V_rmse up to each recorded slot; mixed physical units.
selection.sum_mape: Independent minimum valid Q_mape + I_mape + V_mape up to each recorded slot; percent.
selection.failed_slots: Consume budget; excluded from both minima.
selection.aggregate_curves: Median and seed min/max only where every expected seed has a recorded slot and metric.
selection.at_budget: Statistics over seeds with the full stated budget only; seed_count is explicit.
selection.timing: UTC start to final observed evaluation includes setup, checkpointing and resume gaps; component sums cover recorded evaluations.

limitations: One simulated target; three seeds do not establish transfer across cells or chemistries.
RMSE and MAPE choose their best candidates independently; every method optimizes RMSE.
Seed bands are descriptive minima/maxima, not confidence intervals.
Missing slots are never extrapolated; incomplete methods cannot support a full-budget comparison.
